originalTitle: Global Market: European shares gain as miners, energy stocks lead; investors track Middle East tensions, earnings
simplifiedContent: European stocks, which are like pieces of companies, went up a bit because of good performance from companies that dig up natural resources (miners) and produce energy. This happened because the prices of these natural resources, like oil and metals, went up. Some other types of companies, like those that make everyday goods, also did well because they reported good results. However, technology companies didn't do as well, possibly because investors are being careful about spending money. Investors are now waiting to see what the US Federal Reserve, a powerful group that controls money, will do next with interest rates.

originalTitle: Global Earnings | Nomura's first-quarter profit jumps 39%, boosted by markets
simplifiedContent: Nomura Holdings, a company that helps people manage their money and does investment banking, made 39% more profit in the first quarter of the year than it did in the same time last year. This happened because the stock market was very active and had high prices, which helped Nomura make more money. The company also made more money from managing wealthy people's investments. This is good news for Nomura, and the company thinks it will be able to make even more deals in the future. This is important because it shows that Nomura is doing well and expects to keep doing well, which could be good for people who have invested in the company.

originalTitle: Devyani International Q1 profit zooms to Rs 17 cr
simplifiedContent: Devyani International, a company that runs restaurants, made a profit of Rs 17 crore in the first quarter of the year, which is a big increase. The company's revenue, or the total amount of money it made, went up by 16.47% to Rs 1,580.51 crore. This is a significant jump, showing that the company is doing well. The company also announced a plan to merge with another company called Sapphire Foods India, which will help create one of the largest restaurant chains in the country. This news matters because it shows that Devyani International is growing and could be a good investment opportunity.

originalTitle: Nithin Kamath warns Zerodha could lose revenue from August 3. Here's what's changing in the stock market
simplifiedContent: Nithin Kamath, the person in charge of Zerodha, is warning that the company might lose some of its revenue starting August 3. This is because the Indian stock market is changing its closing times, which might confuse investors. The change, called the Closing Auction Session, is meant to help improve pricing, but it could also reduce the money that brokerages like Zerodha make by 1-5%. This change might also lead to more questions from customers because the market will be closing at different times. Overall, this change could affect how much money Zerodha makes and how it interacts with its customers.

originalTitle: Goldman Sachs to Motilal Oswal: Institutions buys stake in multibagger stock that has surged 3,18,900% in 5 years
simplifiedContent: Here's a simplified version of the news: A company called Diamond Power and Infrastructure had a big drop in its stock price on Wednesday, but then it started to rise again. This company's stock has done extremely well over the past 5 years, increasing in value by a huge 318,900%. Some big investors, like Goldman Sachs, have bought a stake in this company. This could be a sign that these investors think the company will continue to do well, which is why it's worth paying attention to. The fact that the stock price turned back up after a drop may also be a positive sign for the company.

originalTitle: Adani Ports Q1 results: Profit climbs 9% YoY to  ₹3,620 crore, revenue jumps 19%
simplifiedContent: Adani Ports, a company, just released its financial results for the first quarter of the year. The company made a profit of ₹3,620 crore, which is 9% more than it made in the same time last year. Its revenue, which is the amount of money it earned from its main business activities, also increased by 19% to ₹10,820 crore. This means the company is doing better financially compared to last year. This matters because it can affect the company's stock price and how attractive it is to investors like you.
